restitution: Yes, that is the piece: how sixteen European countries' electricity got cleaner from 2000 to 2024, and how France's weight in Europe's low-carbon total moved. The data is Ember and the Energy Institute via Our World in Data.
takeaway: All 16 countries cleaned up their own electricity between 2000 and 2024, yet France lost 11.8 points of weight in Europe's low-carbon total
claim: None of those: it pairs a change every country shares with France's fall in weight.
subject: France.
comparison: The other 15 countries, all of which cleaned up their own mix.
limits: Shares of 16 European countries only; low-carbon means renewables plus nuclear.
placement: After the paragraph on France's nuclear fleet.
credit: Ember, Energy Institute – Statistical Review of World Energy (2025), via Our World in Data, as of 31 December 2024.
